text:
Maya: Quick sync  PulseLite micro-launch: very small-volume drip aimed at high-intent signups + partner referrals. 2-email flow (announce + reminder). Top priorities: protect deliverability, test preheader dynamics, and collect high-quality webinar RSVPs.

Elliot: Agree. Cohorts: (1) signups last 48h with product use, (2) inbound partner referrals last 30d, (3) small sample of engaged docs readers. Keep target per cohort <8k to preserve sample control.

Sanaa: For localization, use three buckets: US, EMEA, APAC. Use local date formatting and friendly time tokens. Avoid hard timezone strings in subject lines.

Omar: Subject/preheader experiments:
- Variant A: subject "PulseLite: new benchmark snapshot" + preheader static
- Variant B: subject "See the 30s benchmark improvement" + dynamic cohort stat in preheader
Run A/B on 6k sample per region.

Maya: Ops constraints? Sam?

Sam: Ops notes: campaign-runner will handle micro-batches. Recommend ISP throttle map to avoid queueing: SendGrid 4000/hr, Amazon 2500/hr, PartnerX 1200/hr. Canary 3% (partner cohort), ramp steps [10, 40, 100]. Also add a soft-cap for APAC bursts to avoid morning spikes.

Maya: Creative: single-column mobile-first; hero with compact stat line and primary CTA "Reserve a spot". Secondary link to deck. Keep GIFs under 120KB.

Elliot: I'll own copy + A/B mapping. Sanaa owns localization and preheader tokens. Omar will handle the partner cohort sample + UTM tagging. Sam will stage the run. Maya owns reporting.

Sam: Ops snippet (example):
```
campaign: pulselite-microlaunch-v1
canary_pct: 3
ramp: [10,40,100]
isp_throttle: {"SendGrid":4000, "Amazon":2500, "PartnerX":1200}
regions: ["US","EMEA","APAC"]
apac_soft_cap/hr: 2000
```
I'll translate to YAML and post the run link.

Sanaa: Also recommend a fallback text-first template for image-blocking ISPs and a distinct tracking param so we can segment click behavior.

Maya: KPIs: deliverability (bounces/blocks), open rate, CTA click rate, webinar RSVPs, deck downloads. Stop rules: spam_complaint >0.05% or block_rate >0.5% in canary.

deliverability-bot: Monitor created: pulselite-deliv (id: dlv_pul_009). Alerts set: hard_bounce>0.2%, spam_complaint>0.05%, block_rate>0.5%.

Omar: I'll export partner cohort and add UTMs. ETA tomorrow AM.

Elliot: Copy drafts by EOD. Plan to run A/B on Monday's canary.

Maya: Thanks team. Keep this thread minimal; flag any deliverability oddities ASAP. :sparkles:
